name: Deferred Shading with Approximate Normals
aliases: Deferred Shading with Layer Separation Heuristic
definition: A technique to calculate view-dependent lighting in layered rendering by storing normal vectors per fragment and performing shading in a deferred step before compositing, rather than multiplying shading coefficients with fragment color before warping.
summary: Deferred Shading with Approximate Normals calculates view-dependent lighting by accumulating weighted gradient-based normals per ray segment, reducing noise and improving specular highlights compared to depth-gradient methods.
